# uptimekuma_notification_sevenio (Resource)

Seven.io SMS notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_sevenio" "example" {
  name    = "Seven.io SMS Notification"
  api_key = "your_sevenio_api_key"
  sender  = "+491234567890"
  to      = "+491111111111"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_sevenio" "write_only" {
  name = "Seven.io with a write-only secret"

  sender = "+491234567890"
  to     = "+491111111111"

  api_key_wo         = "your_sevenio_api_key"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `sender` (String) Sender name or phone number
- `to` (String) Recipient phone number

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Seven.io API key for authentication. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) seven.io API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean) Attach this notification to all existing monitors. This is a one-time action: it runs when the notification is created with `true`, or when the value changes from `false` to `true`. Other updates do not attach it again, so monitors detached from the notification later stay detached. Uptime Kuma does not store the value, so the provider keeps it from the configuration. An imported notification starts with `false`.
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
